Although naltrexone does not appear to be hepatotoxic at the oral dosage of 50 mg daily used for alcohol dependence, caution is recommended in patients with liver disease;3 careful monitoring is recommended if it is given with disulfiram since hepatotoxic- ity could potentially be increased. Other opioid antagonists have also been studied. Preliminary results7,8 suggest that nalmefene may also be effective, although there is insufficient evidence to recommend its use.2 1.
